title: Adic object conditions for the explicit pushed tower
statement: Let X be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], let T_n, i_n, j_n, hi_n and ai_n be as in [lem-weil-pbc-thickening-system-pushforward-functor], and let J be an ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Assume j_n is closed with kernel J^(n+1). For every coherent thickening system M [def-weil-pbc-coherent-thickening-system], the explicitly constructed inverse system P(M) satisfies IsCoherentFormalModule J [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]: its terms are coherent, J^(n+1) kills term n, and its adjacent map is the canonical quotient by J^(n+1) followed by an isomorphism.

proof.text: Install the closed-immersion hypotheses from hgeom. Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian makes each T_n locally Noetherian; the coherent/finite-type criterion gives quasi-coherence of M_n. Apply isCoherent_pushforward_of_isFinite directly to the closed, hence finite, j_n, obtaining coherence of each pushed term. No categorical equivalence is needed.

The multiplication-image power inclusion is monic by two-step induction. The affine-section lemma identifies its range with J(U)^r for every positive r; IdealSheafData.range_toModulesι_app gives the same range for (J^r).toModulesι. Reuse AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.subobject_le_of_affine_range from AffinePushforwardIdealProduct (import all exposes this private theorem), which uses the existing hom_zero_of_affine helper, to prove equality of these subobjects: restrict a composite with the other inclusion's cokernel projection to the affine basis, where it vanishes, then use sheaf separatedness; kernel.lift and the abelian image factorization give the desired factorization. Subobject.isoOfMkEqMk yields power_inclusion_iso respecting both inclusions. Tensor this isomorphism with the ambient module and use imageSubobject_iso_comp to identify multiplication images. Closed pushforward annihilation, with hgeom identifying the kernel, makes multiplication by J^(n+1) zero on all sections; the sheafification adjunction and pure-tensor induction give product_zero_iff. Transfer the resulting zero object through the product isomorphism.

Use IsClosedImmersion.of_comp_isClosedImmersion and hi_n to prove i_n closed. Its kernel is recovered by comap_map_of_isClosedImmersion for j_(n+1). Then map_ker, hi_n, hgeom and comap_pow give i_n.ker=(J.comap j_(n+1))^(n+1). These are explicit rewrites of ideal data; no affine computation remains.

The private quotient_unit_power helper uses power_inclusion_iso and product_inclusion_iso to identify the formal quotient with the cokernel of multiplication by i_n.ker. A cokernel.mapIso respecting the projection transports the existing closed-immersion unit-quotient isomorphism to the formal quotient. Compose with the pushforward of leftAdjointUniq to transport its projection equation from the lemma's chosen adjunction to ai_n, using unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. Obtain the quotient pushforward comparison rho from closedImmersion_pushforward_idealPowers for j_(n+1). Compose rho, the pushforward of this unit quotient, the twice-pushed M.comparison n and thickeningPushforwardComparison. Rewrite the quotient projection equation with the rho equation, Functor.map_comp and the unit quotient equation; Adjunction.homEquiv_unit identifies the result with the explicit transition. thickeningSystemPushforward_transition identifies that map with the inverse-system successor arrow. This supplies the third conjunct.

lean.statement: theorem thickeningSystemPushforward_isAdic {X : Scheme.{v}} [IsNoetherian X] {T : ℕ → Scheme.{v}} {i : ∀ n, T n ⟶ T (n + 1)} (j : ∀ n, T n ⟶ X) (hi : ∀ n, i n ≫ j (n + 1) = j n) (ai : ∀ n, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i n)) (J : X.IdealSheafData) (hgeom : ∀ n, IsClosedImmersion (j n) ∧ (j n).ker = J ^ (n + 1)) (M : CoherentThickeningSystem T i) : IsCoherentFormalModule J ((thickeningSystemPushforward j hi ai).obj M)
